name: issue-1426-close-tab-in-pane
description: docs/specs/m4-split-panes.md, close tab in a pane: pages a, b, c and d each open alone; in the side panel 2G space j space j space Enter makes the split a | b | c; gt shows d alone and gT brings the split back, c focused. x (tab.close) closes c and selects b, the pane core focuses next, so the split stays on screen instead of Firefox's next tab in the strip (d). x again closes b, the last two panes: the split ends and a shows alone, not d.

steps.keys: 2 G space j space j space enter
